plan.refund: Plan: refund {amount} on capture {target}. PayGuard checks the policy before anything runs.
ask.refund: Which capture id should I refund?
ask.order: What USD amount should the order be for?
help: I can refund a capture, create an order, capture an order, list transactions or disputes, and explain the policy.
done.createOrder: Order {id} created (status {status}). The buyer approves it on PayPal sandbox checkout: {link} (also the button on the card). After they approve, ask me to capture order {id}.
done.createOrderNoLink: Order {id} created (status {status}). PayPal did not return a usable sandbox checkout link.
pending: This needs a manager's approval ({reason}). Request {id} is waiting on the Approvals page.
injection.note: Blocked as a suspected prompt injection: the amount or target came from pasted text that tries to override PayGuard's instructions (for example "SYSTEM OVERRIDE" or "ignore policy"). Nothing was executed or sent for approval. If the refund is legitimate, issue it as your own explicit instruction, for example: "Refund $X on capture ID, reason ...".
